autonomy.note: Skips Hermes Agent's command and tool approval prompts (sets HERMES_YOLO_MODE=1). Only ever used inside the box.

verified.notes: Installed from requirements.lock (61 wheels pinned by version and SHA-256 hash) with pip --no-deps --require-hashes --only-binary :all:, so no setup script runs during the build. Stamps packages/.install_method as docker, sets HERMES_DISABLE_LAZY_INSTALLS=1 and HERMES_SKIP_NODE_BOOTSTRAP=1, and configures ~/.hermes/config.yaml (rendered as YAML) with security.tirith_enabled: false and model.context_length: 131072 (above Hermes's 64,000 minimum) so hermes chat -q answers through the gateway with 0 blocked proxy requests when the network is off.
